"""Compute answer.json from inputs/requests.jsonl and inputs/owners.csv."""
import csv, json, math, collections, sys

LOG = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "inputs/requests.jsonl"
OWNERS = "inputs/owners.csv"

rows = [json.loads(l) for l in open(LOG) if l.strip()]
n = len(rows)
ms = sorted(float(r["ms"]) for r in rows)
rank = math.ceil(0.95 * n)                 # nearest-rank, 1-based
p95 = ms[rank - 1]

errors = sum(1 for r in rows if int(r["status"]) >= 500)
error_rate = round(errors / n, 4)

owner = {r["endpoint"]: r["team"] for r in csv.DictReader(open(OWNERS))}
by_team = collections.Counter()
for r in rows:
    if int(r["status"]) >= 500:
        by_team[owner.get(r["endpoint"], "UNKNOWN")] += 1
best = max(by_team.values())
team = min(t for t, c in by_team.items() if c == best)

ans = {"p95_latency_ms": p95, "error_rate": error_rate, "team_most_5xx": team}
json.dump(ans, open("answer.json", "w"), indent=2)
print(json.dumps(ans))
EOF

import json,random
random.seed(1)
eps=['/api/search','/api/cart','/api/login','/api/orders','/api/profile']
with open('/tmp/t/requests.jsonl','w') as f:
  for i in range(200):
    f.write(json.dumps({'ts':i,'endpoint':random.choice(eps),'status':random.choice([200,200,404,500,503]),'ms':random.randint(5,900)})+'\n')
" && python3 compute_answer.py /tmp/t/requests.jsonl && rm -f answer.json && ls

"""Compute answer.json from inputs/requests.jsonl and inputs/owners.csv."""
import csv, json, math, collections, sys

LOG = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "inputs/requests.jsonl"
OWNERS = "inputs/owners.csv"

rows = [json.loads(l) for l in open(LOG) if l.strip()]
n = len(rows)
ms = sorted(float(r["ms"]) for r in rows)
rank = math.ceil(0.95 * n)                 # nearest-rank, 1-based
p95 = ms[rank - 1]

errors = sum(1 for r in rows if int(r["status"]) >= 500)
error_rate = round(errors / n, 4)

owner = {r["endpoint"]: r["team"] for r in csv.DictReader(open(OWNERS))}
by_team = collections.Counter()
for r in rows:
    if int(r["status"]) >= 500:
        by_team[owner.get(r["endpoint"], "UNKNOWN")] += 1
best = max(by_team.values())
team = min(t for t, c in by_team.items() if c == best)

ans = {"p95_latency_ms": p95, "error_rate": error_rate, "team_most_5xx": team}
json.dump(ans, open("answer.json", "w"), indent=2)
print(json.dumps(ans))
